question: Should this stacked ledger expansion merge only after its prerequisites land and the final hosted success and intentional-failure artifacts are inspected?
rationale: The draft changes trusted multi-job automation but still targets an open feature branch, so its final current-main integration behavior is not yet available for review.

options.title: Validate final stacked workflow
